detail: As governor, Caesar conquers all of Gaul, ending with the siege of Alesia in 52 BCE, where the Gallic leader Vercingetorix surrenders. The war gives him vast wealth and a loyal army.
label: 58–50 BCE
note: Added for context; not from the reading notes.
title: Caesar conquers Gaul
